svg.title: Cryptographic temporal commitment evidence
svg.desc: Mobile-first flow showing a temporal commitment with event, time, scope, schema, and ordering claims; exact content identity; signer attestation; local predecessor evidence; optional external witness evidence; and separate currentness and authority evaluation. It explicitly states that signatures do not prove trusted event time, predecessor chains do not prove complete or unique history, and none of these layers grants authority.
svg.text: Cryptographic temporal commitments
Make temporal claims tamper-evident without turning cryptography into authority.
DO NOT COLLAPSE THESE CLAIMS
content identity != signer trust
signed time != trusted event time
predecessor chain != complete or unique history
cryptographic validity != currentness or authority
Each layer proves only its declared property.
01 TEMPORAL COMMITMENT
Commit the temporal meaning, not just the payload
event / subject / payload digest
event time · observed time · validity interval
scope · domain-schema identity · projection profile/version
stream · sequence · predecessor reference profile + ref
Material mutation -> different content identity
A null-only temporal object is rejected.
Historical identity still does not establish truth or permission.
02 EXACT CONTENT IDENTITY
What exact canonical object?
Optional first profile: UOR-Addr v0.2.0 JSON reference.
Reference profile travels with predecessor and witness references.
UOR identity != signer identity != authority
Core construction and signing remain possible without UOR.
03 SIGNER ATTESTATION
Who endorsed that exact object?
bind content-reference profile + content ref + signer/key profile
valid signature + revoked key can coexist
Historical cryptographic validity need not imply present trust.
Signed event_time=T does not prove the event occurred at T.
04 RELATIVE ORDER EVIDENCE
What local predecessor relation is committed?
recompute predecessor ref · verify reference profile · scope
stream identity · contiguous sequence
Fork detected -> report siblings, choose no canonical child
complete_history_proven = false
non_equivocation_proven = false
A hash pointer is not a global ledger certificate.
05 OPTIONAL EXTERNAL WITNESS
When can an independent service prove existence?
timestamp / inclusion / consistency / freshness adapter evidence
bind subject reference profile + exact subject ref
Witnessed existence by T2 != event occurred at T2.
06 CURRENTNESS + GOVERNANCE STAY SEPARATE
Later supersession does not rewrite the signed historical event.
historical mutation=false · crypto validity unchanged · authority_effect=none
Research #258 · Implementation #259 · Decision candidate ADR-031
